_comment: T1 item 11 (digital) klt erc supply spec for layout/efuse_otp_ctrl.gds, top efuse_otp_ctrl.
Layer numbers are the gf180mcu drawing layers of the curated gf180mcu deck the DRC/LVS
reports already pin: Poly 30/0, Comp 22/0, Contact 33/0, Metal1 34/0 .. Metal5 81/0 with
Via1 35/0, Via2 38/0, Via3 40/0, Via4 41/0, Nwell 21/0, Nplus 32/0, Pplus 31/0.
The stackup covers every power.straps[].layer of layout/pnr-report.json (Metal1, Metal4,
Metal5) and the vias between them, per docs/cli/erc.md's supply-spec rule: a supply net
whose upper strap layers are missing from the stackup reads as several disconnected
islands. Label layers are the pin layers the stream actually carries text on (34/10 rail
labels, 36/10 signal pins, 81/10 the two top-level supply pins).
VDD and VSS are single-domain supplies: no islands (one electrical island each is the
expectation) and no same_net_as tie. The VNW/VPW texts inside the library cells are the
well/substrate-tap pin names, not separate domains: the taps contact the VDD/VSS rails
directly, which is what the ties below assert.
Ties, both wired up through Contact to the Metal1 row rails the tap cells
(power.tapcell_master gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__filltie, distance 15 um) strap:
nwell_vdd -- each merged Nwell 21/0 shape must hold an n-well tap (Comp AND Nplus, the
gf180mcu tap boolean; inside Nwell that selects taps only, PMOS source/drain are Comp AND
Pplus) that reaches VDD.
psub_vss -- gf180mcu bulk is a p-type substrate with no drawn p-well, so the substrate
region is the top-cell extent minus Nwell (well_complement_of); its p-taps (Comp AND Pplus
outside Nwell; NMOS source/drain in the substrate are Comp AND Nplus) must reach VSS.
